description: Seven saved tool-response batches contain 16 exact search inputs and 214 captured result headers. This is open-web discovery, not a systematic historical archive; LexisNexis was not available and March has not been exhaustively searched.
required_followup: Run additional weekly/date-window and regional-sector follow-ups in Spanish and English; compare contemporary local, national, official and civil-society reporting. Preserve query batches and raw outputs.

description: The 16 March national CUT mobilization occurred in six named cities, but available body-reviewed Caracol report has no headcount at any individual site; national multi-city activity cannot substitute for a single-crowd count.
required_followup: Find a contemporary local report or official record quantifying one simultaneous gathering in one city.

description: 8 March women’s-rights marches are reported in multiple cities. Available excerpts give a combined Bogotá count for three marches and describe general rights demands; no body-reviewed evidence establishes a single-site threshold or a clear demand on Colombian state/policy.
required_followup: Find accessible local body reporting with a single-site count, exact demands, organizers and state/policy target; do not pool the three Bogotá marches.

description: The regional miners’ strike/protests began 2 March according to captured excerpts, but a reported regional 'hundreds' is not a site-level simultaneous crowd. Search excerpts say mediation enabled suspension after about a month, but exact event end and scope remain unknown. Connection to February Nechí blockade is unproven.
required_followup: Obtain body-readable contemporaneous evidence for local gathering counts, named sites, local demands and exact suspension/outcome date; test whether February Nechí action is same episode without assuming it.

description: A 9 March miners’ blockade at Buriticá is described in two search excerpts as solidarity with Bajo Cauca/Nordeste, but its local turnout, target and relation to the larger strike remain unresolved.
required_followup: Find accessible article body or other permitted sources for count, demand, organizers, local origin and end; decide whether local action is separate or part of the regional episode.

description: The 23 March Pedagógica march is supported by one live report and a local estimate of ~1,000 students, but the report does not state when the march concluded or provide independent count confirmation. A separate ~50 Universidad Nacional group has no identified demand.
required_followup: Find independent contemporary accounts for the Pedagógica crowd and close; identify demands and threshold precision for the separate Universidad Nacional crowd.

description: The ADE teachers’ public march on 28 March is confirmed and the close is reported, but no single-site teacher headcount is provided; strike participation or union membership cannot serve as turnout.
required_followup: Find body-readable contemporaneous local reporting or a reliable event-level count at the Planetarium, route or Plaza de Bolívar.

description: The 28 March Rappi march meets threshold based on local reporting of ~150 at the Parque de la 93 gathering and ~300 on route, plus Semana’s qualitative 'hundreds'. Independent source methods and exact crowd maximum remain unclear.
required_followup: Seek another independent source or official account documenting attendance and endpoint; do not substitute the advance target near 1,000 for actual turnout.

description: The 3 March health-reform action has firm local evidence from Cartagena, but other cities named in pre-event or search-result coverage have not been individually verified for occurrence, count or closure.
required_followup: Check local news and official sources for other city sites; preserve local turnout and ending evidence without summing cities.

description: No March event was confirmed as a continuation of a February-owned action. February Nechí miners and the March regional strike may relate, but current evidence does not establish shared organizers, demands, site, or uninterrupted activity.
required_followup: Search contemporaneous February-to-March records for exact onset, interruption, geography and participant/organizer continuity; keep candidates distinct until supported.

description: Platform-driver actions are body-confirmed in Pereira and Cartagena on 15 March and reported in Medellín/Bogotá excerpts. Relationship across city actions, exact demands, and single-site turnout remain unresolved; the Pereira leader’s 9,000-vehicle network estimate is not attendance.
required_followup: Find exact local attendance and organizer/demand evidence in each city; determine whether they were part of one coordinated mobilization or distinct actions; do not sum cities or use network membership as crowd size.
